changelog: New Bot Manager with named LDPlayer/MuMu assignments, isolated bot processes, saved account plans and per-bot logs/statistics.
Redesigned black-and-gold settings: numbered account configs, continuous SET forms, quantity grids, copying, root/Supercell/current-account selection and account resume.
Selected-emulator Native capture is primary in both editions, with validated ADB fallback and bounded startup recovery. MuMu supports native input streams.
Local PP-OCRv6 Small models are bundled for upgrade text and army capacity; Supercell switching retains Tesseract. No model downloads are required.
Independent persistent building, laboratory and pet upgrade queues, builder reservation and shared payment-journal safeguards.
Home supports basic army fallback, Event Troops, Tactical Blueprint, Battle Pass rewards and optional collection, clan joining, requests and obstacle tasks.
Reduced repeated successful-state scans and OCR; conditional recovery uses workflow frames and deployment uses continuous input streams. Whole-run speed gains are not claimed.

Free: two bots, five account configs per bot, all supported troops/spells/Event Troops/targets, walls/rewards, cycles/resume, three building selections plus three lab selections and one pet per account.
Free uses Home or Builder across each bot plan. Pro supports unlimited bots, 50 configs per bot, both villages in one plan, full queues and optional automation/Discord notifications.
Downgrade preserves saved settings. New-building placement, Builder collector harvesting and other unavailable controls remain disabled in both editions.
Account Creation is an independent Pro/root-required engine. Broader tutorial/root switching, optional-task and gameplay acceptance remains pending; see release limitations.
Standalone Windows x64 package includes its Python runtime, local OCR, ADB and input helpers; signed updates preserve user data. No Python installation is needed.
